name: The Intern
source:
It's been a bad day at the office, but things are looking up when the new intern, Britt, walks into Dylan's life. Carrying a coffee and stealing his heart, young Britt stirs a darker yearning inside of him.

Britt is stunning, kind, friendly, optimistic, and an obedient, unquestioning slave. See through Dylan's eyes as he pushes his little puppy to the limit and beyond in the office and back at his place, in his secret special room. 

Maybe together they will also find someone else to play with?
